title: Mapping the Resilience Gap: Reproducing AILuminate Jailbreak Benchmarks on Open-Weight Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: replication builds evidentiary base for benchmark trust. However, this is a replication study that confirms/extends existing findings rather than discovering new mechanisms or defenses.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Uses existing AILuminate taxonomy and StrongReject scorer. Running 3-5 open-weight models through standardized attacks is doable but requires familiarity with multiple frameworks. Inspect Evals integration helps. Medium difficulty.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 3-5 models across multiple attack categories is moderately broad. Per-category resilience gap computation is well-defined. Loading and running multiple models strains 30 hours and medium compute. Could be scoped to 3 models.
